judgement.reason: Snipe-IT is a single Laravel web app on MySQL whose uploads can be moved to S3 with a contained change, so DEPLOYABLE_WITH_CHANGES is appropriate.

reviews.findingEvidence: Durable local filesystem state declared: VOLUME /var/lib/snipeit (Dockerfile)
reviews.reason: The Dockerfile symlinks uploads, private uploads, backups and OAuth keys into /var/lib/snipeit, and no shown production setting selects S3 for that data (the S3 disk lines in .env.example are commented out and docker.env is not shown).
